1.issue: Prior stem was ambiguous: births and reclassification can both increase measured urban population without migration. New stem isolates reclassification of existing rural residents.
1.B: Natural increase among already urban residents does not reclassify existing rural residents
1.D: Building construction alone does not establish Census reclassification

2.issue: Distinguish HMDA administrative expansion from physical urbanisation
2.C: False: GHMC municipal and HMDA metropolitan jurisdictions differ
2.D: False: HMDA area includes revenue villages

14.issue: Replace trivial distractors with distinct hydrological misconceptions
14.A: False: impervious surfaces reduce direct infiltration
14.B: Correct: increased and accelerated runoff with lower infiltration
14.C: False: drains route runoff but do not make imperviousness irrelevant
14.D: False: drainage does not eliminate flood risk

20.issue: Differentiate built-up footprint, statutory boundary, and census-town status
20.A: False: no automatic annexation per building
20.B: False: census town need not become municipal corporation
20.C: False: remotely observed built-up area differs from notified boundary
20.D: Correct: physical and administrative change may differ

22.issue: Original key incorrectly implied wastewater reuse was universally necessary; safe treatment and appropriate discharge also count
22.B: Correct: actual flows safely treated, discharge or reuse as appropriate
22.C: Sewer length alone is an output
22.D: Rated capacity does not establish actual treatment quality
